aliases: professional scrum master iii psm iii
exam_rules: Open-book, not proctored. Taken directly on scrum.org. One browser tab only recommended. No time banking — timer runs continuously. No formal expiry on certifications.
id_requirements: No ID required for online assessments. Email address and scrum.org account required.

lifecycle.summary: Scrum.org still sells PSM III: 'The Professional Scrum Master™ III (PSM III) certification validates your deep understanding of how to apply Scrum, Scrum practices, and the Scrum Values', with a live 'Add to Cart / Buy Now' at '$500 USD One-time payment' and 'Certification Details $500 USD per attempt ... Time limit: 2.5 hours (150 minutes) Number of Questions: 24 Format: Essay questions only'. No retirement wording appears.

official_study_resources.notes: The Scrum Guide is the primary reference for all scrum.org assessments
official_study_resources.title: Scrum Guide

official_study_resources.notes: Free practice assessments available for all certification levels
official_study_resources.title: Open Assessments

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period after failed attempt. Full exam fee required for retake.

testing_centers.notes: All assessments taken online directly at scrum.org — no testing center required
